slices.title: Build Pipeline Follow-up
slices.jtbd: When implementing the build pipeline follow-up for this epic, I want to configure the actuator health check and remove target artifacts, so that the container starts healthily and the repository remains clean.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean clone of the repository, When docker-compose up -d runs, Then all services start correctly and report healthy via a real actuator health-check endpoint.
Given the codebase state, When changes are reviewed, Then no target/ build artifacts are committed.
Given the PR summary is reviewed, Then it records one concrete blocker or follow-up.

slices.title: API Slice Follow-up
slices.jtbd: When implementing the migration test follow-up for this epic, I want to exercise the actual shipped SQL patch, so that the datastore runtime contract behaves exactly as tested.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the atomic UPDATE patch, When the migration test is executed, Then it explicitly targets existing tables and exercises the actual shipped migration.
Given the PR summary is reviewed, Then evidence of auditor reprocessing and blocker recording is included.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive migration test successes to 0%
